method: Ten accepted initial native image_gen atlases and the actual archived native correction calls after inspection of local references and generated poses. Missing, incomplete or clipped rows are replaced only by new native rows. Sharp only extracts alpha-separated cells, applies shared per-phase scale and baseline normalization, and builds review contacts. No limb, pose, clone, weapon or effect is procedurally painted or synthesized. Renderer-only body-stature metadata uses the same single source-wide body scale calibrated from an inspected biped BODY190px reference or a separately measured quadruped ear-height110px reference for Dogmeat. The native body-height ratio of crouches and jumps, density changes between native sources, and baseline244 are preserved; no body or weapon is redrawn or cropped. Concrete source facts and blocked page reads are archived separately; global 1:1 is not certified.
